items.html: And this is the matter of the manner of her sawing: for at first these judgments came to her by means of ZA, who gives her the aspect of the Gevurot that are in his Daat, since the Supernal Ima was spreading within him. But now that a deep sleep fell upon him, the Supernal Ima departed from him; and also his mochin, which were within them, inside the spread of the NNH of the Supernal Ima in him, departed from him, as is known. And then also the side of Gevura (Atara deGevura) in the Daat departed from him.
